epoch_rule: Median of development best epochs 10, 13, 6; fixed before test evaluation
checkpoint_rule: Final epoch only; no early stopping or test-based selection
schedule: Linear decay across the fixed 10-epoch final training budget; no warmup
frequency_reference: Original training split positive entity spans; same thresholds as development
reporting: Report every seed and mean/sample standard deviation; do not select a seed by test score
test_policy: Load test only after all final models are trained; evaluate once per model; no test-driven tuning
